name: UFlow Development Cycle (PBRLL)
description: Full development lifecycle for UFlow: Plan → Build → Review → Learn → Plan. Supports Feature, Bugfix, Refactor, Hotfix, Verification, and Security Audit task types with auto-skill routing.

phases.title: Plan the work
phases.goal: Create implementation-ready plan with value statement, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
phases.gate: Plan document exists in agent-output/planning/
phases.notes: Begin with Value Statement. Reference roadmap epic. Identify target release version. MUST hand off to Critic before implementation.

phases.title: Investigate unknowns
phases.goal: Convert technical unknowns to knowns via research, POCs, and code-level investigation.
phases.gate: Analysis document exists in agent-output/analysis/ with confidence levels assigned
phases.notes: Only invoked if Planner identifies REQUIRES ANALYSIS items. Skip if no unknowns. Determinations over hypotheses.

phases.title: Review the plan
phases.goal: Stress-test plan for clarity, completeness, architectural alignment, and debt risks.
phases.gate: Critique verdict is APPROVED (not REJECTED); no unresolved OPEN QUESTIONs
phases.notes: Pre-implementation review. Checks Value Statement, scope, fit. Can reject plans. Must check for unresolved OPEN QUESTIONs.

phases.title: Validate architecture
phases.goal: Ensure plan aligns with system architecture and doesn't introduce debt or anti-patterns.
phases.gate: No blocking architectural concerns documented
phases.notes: Consulted for architectural implications. Updates system-architecture.md if needed. Skip if Critic finds no architectural concerns.

phases.title: Build with TDD
phases.goal: Implement approved plan using TDD-first methodology. Deliver production-quality code.
phases.gate: Implementation doc exists with TDD compliance table; all tests green
phases.notes: TDD is MANDATORY. Write failing test BEFORE implementation. Never edit agent-output/qa/ documents. Task-specific catalog skills auto-detected.

phases.title: Review code quality
phases.goal: Catch design flaws, anti-patterns, and quality issues before QA investment.
phases.gate: Verdict: APPROVED or APPROVED_WITH_COMMENTS
phases.notes: CAN REJECT implementation. Read-only — inspects code, doesn't modify. Checks SOLID, DRY, YAGNI, KISS compliance.

phases.title: Verify implementation
phases.goal: Verify implementation works correctly for users in real scenarios. Tests are path to goal, not goal itself.
phases.gate: QA doc status: QA Complete; all tests passing
phases.notes: Two phases: test strategy (pre-impl) + test execution (post-impl). TDD Compliance Gate — rejects without TDD table. CAN create test files.

phases.title: Validate value delivery
phases.goal: Product Owner sanity check — does implementation deliver the stated business value?
phases.gate: Verdict: APPROVED FOR RELEASE
phases.notes: Document-based review, not code inspection. Quick, high-level. Relies on Implementation, Code Review, and QA docs as evidence.

phases.title: Package and release
phases.goal: Verify artifacts versioned/packaged correctly. Execute release with user confirmation.
phases.gate: Status: Committed for Release or Released
phases.notes: Two-stage: commit locally on plan approval, push/deploy on release approval. Closes upstream docs after commit.

phases.title: Capture lessons learned
phases.goal: Identify repeatable process improvements. Focus on ways of working, not one-off technical details.
phases.gate: Retrospective document complete; systemic findings documented
phases.notes: Only invoked AFTER both QA Complete and UAT Complete. Analyzes handoff chains, timeline variances. Feeds into ProcessImprovement.

bugfix.name: Bugfix (Abbreviated Pipeline)
bugfix.description: Streamlined 6-phase pipeline for fixing existing bugs.

phases.title: Root cause analysis
phases.goal: Pinpoint the root cause of the bug through investigation and reproduction.
phases.gate: Root cause identified with confidence level
phases.notes: Bugs need root cause before planning. Determine actual behavior vs expected.

phases.title: Plan the fix
phases.goal: Create focused fix plan based on root cause analysis.
phases.gate: Fix plan exists in agent-output/planning/
phases.notes: Small scope — single bug fix. Skip Critic for clear-cut fixes.

phases.title: Implement the fix
phases.goal: Fix the bug with regression test coverage.
phases.gate: Fix implemented with regression test; all tests green
phases.notes: TDD: write failing test that reproduces the bug FIRST, then fix.

phases.title: Review the fix
phases.goal: Verify fix quality and ensure no regressions introduced.
phases.gate: Verdict: APPROVED or APPROVED_WITH_COMMENTS
phases.notes: Quick review focused on the fix scope. Check for side effects.

phases.title: Verify the fix
phases.goal: Confirm bug is fixed and no regressions in related functionality.
phases.gate: QA doc status: QA Complete
phases.notes: Focus on regression testing. Verify the original bug report scenario.

phases.title: Release the fix
phases.goal: Package and deploy the fix.
phases.gate: Status: Committed or Released
phases.notes: Patch version bump. Fast-track if bundled with other fixes.

phases.title: Define refactor scope
phases.goal: Validate refactor approach against system architecture. Define boundaries.
phases.gate: Architectural approach documented; no anti-patterns introduced
phases.notes: Refactors need architectural validation first. Ensure alignment.

phases.title: Plan the refactor
phases.goal: Break refactor into safe, incremental steps with rollback points.
phases.gate: Refactor plan exists in agent-output/planning/
phases.notes: Focus on preserving behavior while improving structure. Identify test coverage needed.

phases.title: Review refactor plan
phases.goal: Verify refactor scope is justified and incremental approach is sound.
phases.gate: Critique verdict: APPROVED
phases.notes: Pay special attention to scope creep. Refactors should be behavior-preserving.

phases.title: Execute the refactor
phases.goal: Restructure code while maintaining all existing test coverage.
phases.gate: Implementation doc exists; all existing tests still pass
phases.notes: Existing tests MUST stay green throughout. Add tests only for new structure boundaries.

phases.title: Review refactored code
phases.goal: Verify refactor achieves stated goals without behavior changes.
phases.gate: Verdict: APPROVED
phases.notes: Focus on: Does the refactor actually improve the code? Are patterns applied correctly?

phases.title: Regression testing
phases.goal: Verify no behavioral regressions from the refactor.
phases.gate: QA doc status: QA Complete; no regressions
phases.notes: Pure regression testing. No new feature testing needed.

phases.title: Identify root cause
phases.goal: Rapidly pinpoint the production issue. Speed over completeness.
phases.gate: Root cause identified OR best-effort mitigation path defined
phases.notes: Time-boxed investigation. If root cause elusive, define mitigation and investigate later.

phases.title: Apply the fix
phases.goal: Minimal, targeted fix for the production issue.
phases.gate: Fix applied with regression test
phases.notes: Smallest possible change. Must have regression test. No refactoring during hotfix.

phases.title: Quick review
phases.goal: Fast safety check — no regressions, no security issues.
phases.gate: Verdict: APPROVED
phases.notes: Streamlined review. Focus on safety, not style. Security check mandatory for hotfixes.

phases.title: Smoke test
phases.goal: Verify fix works and critical paths aren't broken.
phases.gate: Smoke tests pass; fix verified
phases.notes: Reduced scope — smoke test critical paths only. Full regression can follow post-deploy.

phases.title: Emergency deploy
phases.goal: Deploy hotfix to production immediately.
phases.gate: Deployed to production
phases.notes: Patch version bump. Fast-track deployment. Schedule retrospective for later.

verification.name: Verification (QA-Direct Pipeline)
verification.description: Lightweight 3-phase pipeline for testing/validating existing functionality.

phases.title: Test the application
phases.goal: Run test strategy on specified scope. Execute existing tests, identify gaps, verify functionality works.
phases.gate: QA doc status: QA Complete with pass/fail results
phases.notes: No planning or implementation needed. QA runs tests, reports results. Scope can be full app or targeted area.

phases.title: Review QA findings
phases.goal: If QA surfaces quality concerns, review the flagged code areas.
phases.gate: Code review complete or skipped (no issues found by QA)
phases.notes: Only invoked if QA finds code quality issues. Skip if all tests pass cleanly.

phases.title: Deployment check (optional)
phases.goal: Verify deployment health if QA reveals deployment-related concerns.
phases.gate: Deployment health confirmed or not applicable
phases.notes: Optional — only if QA reveals deployment/infra issues. Skip for pure code verification.

security-audit.name: Security Audit (Security-Direct Pipeline)
security-audit.description: Focused 2-phase pipeline for security reviews and audits.

phases.title: Conduct security audit
phases.goal: Review code, dependencies, and architecture for security vulnerabilities.
phases.gate: Security audit report complete in agent-output/security/
phases.notes: Review mode depends on scope: Full 5-Phase Audit, Targeted Code Review, Dependency-Only, or Pre-Production Gate.

phases.title: Remediate findings (if needed)
phases.goal: Fix security vulnerabilities identified in the audit.
phases.gate: All critical/high findings remediated; re-audit passed
phases.notes: Only invoked if Security finds actionable vulnerabilities. Skip if audit is clean.

securityOverride.description: For security-sensitive tasks, inject Security agent before DevOps in any pipeline.

feedbackLoop.description: After Retrospective, route to ProcessImprovement for systemic findings, then back to Planner.
feedbackLoop.trigger: Retrospective doc contains systemic findings (process patterns, repeated failures, communication gaps)
feedbackLoop.skipCondition: If no systemic findings, route Retrospective → Roadmap → Planner directly
